commitments.detail: Maintain a safe distance and proper grounding to prevent accidents.
Maintain a safe distance between the generator and solvent storage area.
Ensure all non-essential equipment is turned off to prevent overload.
Maintain a minimum distance of 50 meters between the generator and solvent storage area.
Turn off non-essential chillers to prioritize load on the generator.
Ensure bonded grounding kit is in place and properly used.
